text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends a 40 km/h speed zone on Brooklawn Avenue, between Barkdene Hills and Sunnypoint Crescent (south intersection). The reduction of the speed limit from the current 50 km/h to 40 km/h is technically justified.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Brooklawn Avenue, between Barkdene Hills and Sunnypoint Crescent (south intersection).
